summary: Validated the image upload fix (moving static mount from /uploads to /api/uploads so K8s ingress routes it to the backend). Backend pytest suite (6/6 passed) + Playwright E2E admin flow + curl verification of public URLs all confirm the fix works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1186 lines — should be split into modules (auth, media, services, seed, etc.) as it exceeds the 700-line guideline.
Migration in startup_event runs on every startup with $regex + aggregation update — idempotent but slightly wasteful; consider a one-shot migration flag stored in a `migrations` collection.

Media DELETE endpoint uses Path(m['url']).name which now includes the /api prefix segment in path; still works because it takes only the basename, but building the path from folder+basename via url is fragile — better to store the disk path or filename directly.
CORS is set with allow_origins=['*'] and allow_credentials=True which is invalid per spec (browsers will reject). Consider whitelisting origins.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded 'etudes-fondations' service for E2E upload test; test media row is cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The image upload fix is confirmed working on preview. GET on /api/uploads/<path> returns image/*, GET on /uploads/<path> returns SPA HTML (as expected — the ingress routes only /api/* to backend). Legacy DB URLs were migrated at startup. User needs to redeploy production for the fix to apply there.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: Kubernetes ingress only forwards paths prefixed with /api/* to the backend container (port 8001). Any other path hits the React SPA container which serves index.html for all routes. The previous StaticFiles mount was at /uploads, so image URLs like /uploads/services/foo.png were served as text/html (SPA index) rather than the actual image file. FIX: Moved the mount to /api/uploads in server.py, updated upload_media to emit '/api/uploads/...' URLs, and added a startup migration to backfill existing DB records across media, services (image/hero_image/seo_og_image/gallery), projects, slides, testimonials, team, partners, blog_posts and content_blocks. VERIFIED: curl of /api/uploads/... returns 200 image/png; admin upload flow shows working thumbnail; persistence across reload confirmed; all migrated URLs in /api/admin/media list start with /api/uploads/.
